title: 第3章 梭哈百万，首吃涨停，日入十万
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
江云不大，创造神话。

    当然。

    这都是本地人调侃的。

    实际上江云县，就是一个贫穷落后的地方。

    到处都是陈旧古老的。

    房地产虽然在搞，但房价在两千到三千之间。

    真要买房的也没多少。

    要买也是去距离不过一个小时左右的市区买。

    反正房地产在当地也是要死不活的。

    ……

    “爸。”

    李西海准时八点起床，爸妈比他起的还早，早饭已经做好了。

    李父放下报纸，“吃饭。”

    李母调侃道：“刚准备去叫你，你自己就起来了。”

    “早睡早起好啊。”

    李西海嘿嘿的笑了笑。

    老妈应该不知道他为什么这么早起来吧。

    李父瞥了他一眼，一切尽在不言中。

    股市九点半开始，八点起来收拾收拾，做做准备功夫，了解资讯，刚好差不多。

    “下午你妈提前一个小时下班。”

    “去银行转钱。”

    李父说道。

    李西海抬头道：“爸，我上午就要用。”

    “这就要投资了？”

    “对。”

    “行。”李父道：“让你妈请个假，先给你转钱。”

    “谢谢爸。”

    有这样开明的父母，就是好啊。

    不过，他也很清楚父母的是有底线的。

    这次炒股要是亏了超过一半，就要收手，听从家里的安排。

    对了。

    还有相亲。

    这不，想什么来什么。

    李母说道：

    “你答应好了的，同意相亲。”

    “我就帮你联系那些阿姨嬢嬢，帮你找了。”

    “行。”

    李西海一口答应下来，相亲嘛，看看又不会掉什么。

    万一真相到适合的，谈谈也无所谓。

    “小妹呢？”

    “已经上学去了。”

    “不对啊，昨天不是周末嘛。”

    “你忘了她上艺体要补习的啊？”

    李西海这才想起，小妹准备走艺体生的路线。

    以后想考影视学院，当演员。

    也不知道怎么想的。

    反正家里都是放养，只要是有目标有方向，自己拿主意就行。

    吃完饭。
content_en:
Jiang Yun is not big, creating a myth.

    certainly.

    This is what the locals joke about.

    In fact, Jiangyun County is a poor and backward place.

    Everywhere is old and ancient.

    Although real estate is being developed, the price is between 2,000 and 3,000.

    Not many people really want to buy a house.

    If you want to buy it, go to the city which is only about an hour away.

    Anyway, real estate in the local area is going to die.

    …

    "Dad."

    Li Xihai got up at eight o'clock on time. His parents got up earlier than him, and breakfast was already prepared.

    Father Li put down the newspaper and said, "Eat."

    Mother Li joked: "I was just about to call you, but you got up by yourself."

    "It's good to go to bed early and get up early."

    Li Xihai smiled.

    Mom probably doesn't know why he got up so early.

    Father Li glanced at him and said nothing.

    The stock market starts at 9:30, and I get up at 8:00 to tidy up, make preparations, and get information, which is about right.

    "Your mother will get off work an hour early in the afternoon."

    "Go to the bank and transfer money."

    Father Li said.

    Li Xihai raised his head and said, "Dad, I need it in the morning."

    "Is this going to be an investment?"

    "Yes."

    "Okay." Father Li said, "Let your mother take a leave and transfer the money to you first."

    "Thanks dad."

    It’s great to have such open-minded parents.

    However, he also knows very well that his parents have a bottom line.

    If you lose more than half of your stock trading this time, you should stop and follow your family's arrangements.

    Right.

    And blind dates.

    No, whatever comes to mind.

    Mother Li said:

    "You agreed, agreed to the blind date."

    "I will help you contact those aunties and help you find them."

    "Okay."

    Li Xihai agreed immediately. They wanted to go on a blind date to see if they wouldn't lose anything.

    If the truth comes to a point where it's appropriate, it doesn't matter if we talk about it.

    "Where's my little sister?"

    "Already gone to school."

    "No, yesterday was not the weekend."

    "Did you forget that she needs tutoring for arts and sports?"

    Only then did Li Xihai remember that his younger sister was planning to become an arts and sports student.

    In the future, I want to go to a film and television academy and become an actor.

    I don’t know what to think.

    Anyway, the family is free-range, as long as there is a goal and a direction, you can make your own decisions.

    After dinner.
